notes.title: The Last Cube - Our upcoming puzzle game
notes.notes:
Greetings, our dear friends of Shavytown! ːsteamhappyː

For the past 3 years we have been working hard on our upcoming title, where we have definitely stepped up a notch regarding our ambition, production value, and design work. We present to you -  [b]The Last Cube[/b]: a science fiction cube puzzle game with a light narrative.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26671828/7a019145cb727241d48e668f9a428a10f82c5297.png[/img]

So what is all this Cube business about? In this game, you play as the last sentient cube left in the world. You were awakened for a purpose—save this peculiar world from collapsing by solving puzzle tracks left by your ancestors. The puzzles involve collecting colorful stickers on your cube's faces, and using each sticker's unique powers to overcome 3D challenges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26671828/fce6aa5c691801f768655f46ae0632e9da016c21.gif[/img]

During the game you will venture through six colorful themes of the cube-world. New mechanics are introduced at appropriate intervals to keep the experience fresh and keep you engaged. Mechanics are mixed and developed throughout the game, and there is no doubt your cubing skills will be put to a test. Levels are also sprawled with secrets that unlock bonus levels - so exploration is rewarded.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26671828/57c310439711edd3772774184cc4f4a7ec64fdcb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26671828/fa891cc451a8e8657460dcd64533f87722d15cb4.png[/img]

[b]Be sure to wishlist the game and explore more videos, screenshots and details at:[/b] http://steam.lastcubegame.com/

Want to try out a short demo of the game? The Last Cube will be featured on Steam Game Festival, Summer Edition, running on June 9th through 14th 2020. During that time we will have a playable demo of The Last Cube where you can get right in the puzzle action and see for yourself what we will have in store. Set yourself a reminder at: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/gamefestival

To stay up to date with the game's updates, news and behind-the-scenes follow us on social media, which includes a subreddit and a Discord server. You can also ask us any questions you have there!

[b]Reddit[/b]: https://www.reddit.com/r/thelastcube/
[b]Discord[/b]: http://discord.gg/cNFt8Mb
[b]Twitter[/b]: https://twitter.com/improxgames
[b]Instagram[/b]: https://www.instagram.com/improxgames/
[b]Facebook[/b]: https://www.facebook.com/improxgames/
And [b]"Improx Games"[/b] in YouTube

If you're interested in beta testing The Last Cube in the future, the Discord server is the best way to stay updated on that.

Thanks for supporting us during the Trimmer Tycoon phase. It was an awesome way to start our company and introduce ourselves into the world of game development. Since then, we have learned so much about programming, design, art, marketing, and other skills in game development, and our way of working as a team is ever-improving. We are super proud at the work in The Last Cube we have done so far and super hyped to deliver it to you. Thank you, keep rolling, and keep an eye on us! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: REBIRTH Update Live!
notes.notes:
We have made changes to Trimmer Tycoon to make it more enjoyable and fast-paced:

 - Added a beard-o-meter to track your beard correctness
 - Tweaked money gains and added multipliers (BEARD STREAKS) for doing well
 - Improved the tutorial


The game is now overall easier, especially in the beginning. That is because we noted that an average person played only a few minutes, and by reading all your feedback we realized that the beginning was too hard for many players / many players did not understand the importance of being fast and placing decorations.

Because the mechanics have changed significantly, we have also reset the leaderboards.

We have also fixed many bugs. The SCISSORS now (finally) always work! We've also fixed a bunch of other, small, bugs. We hope you find the REBORN Trimmer Tycoon fun and try to become the next millionaires of Shavytown!

notes.title: Multiple bug fixes live!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the game would freeze after going back and forth between the menu and the game and then trying to access the Computer in-game
[*] Fixed a bug where money-related achievements weren't being tracked on Steam
[*] (Hopefully) fixed a bug where some scores weren't being fully uploaded to Steam Leaderboards
[*] Made wall and floor textures larger so they shouldn't be blurry anymore on super-high resolutions
[*] Added a blinking effect to the Computer to make it more noticeable to new players
[/list]

Please keep reporting bugs if you find them! Many of these bugs were found through people's reports. Thank you all so much for playing and enjoying Trimmer Tycoon!

notes.notes:

Please report any bugs you find as you play in the discussions section!
